ic_name: SD Memory Card (SD Simplified Physical Layer Specification)

fields.security_summary: The base Physical Layer protocol provides only data-integrity protection (CRC7 + CRC16 + start/end framing) — not confidentiality / authentication. Content protection and access control are layered above via Card Lock/Unlock (CMD42, optional COP), CPRM (Content Protection for Recordable Media, optional), and the SD Security Specification (Part 3, separate document). CID is factory-unique and used by some applications as a card-identity fingerprint, but the bus-level read of CID is not authenticated.

security_features.name: CRC7 (CMD line)
security_features.description: Polynomial x^7 + x^3 + 1; per 48-bit CMD frame. Defeats wire-level bit-flip errors only — NOT a cryptographic MAC.

security_features.name: CRC16 (DAT line, per active lane)
security_features.scope: data block payload on each DAT line
security_features.description: Polynomial x^16 + x^12 + x^5 + 1 (CRC-CCITT). Defeats wire-level bit-flip errors. Not a cryptographic MAC.

security_features.name: Card Lock / Unlock (CMD42)
security_features.description: Set / clear a password on the card. While locked, only CMD42, CMD13, CMD16, basic class-0 commands are allowed. CMD42 ERASE clears the password and erases all user data. Password length up to 16 bytes.

security_features.name: Card Ownership Protection (COP)
security_features.description: Added in v6.00. Stronger Lock/Unlock variant with Forced Erase Protection (FEP) — protects against malicious forced-erase attacks on locked cards.

security_features.name: Permanent Write Protect (PERM_WRITE_PROTECT in CSD)
security_features.description: Set via CMD27 PROGRAM_CSD; once set, can never be cleared. All write commands return CSR.WP_VIOLATION.

security_features.name: Temporary Write Protect (TMP_WRITE_PROTECT in CSD)
security_features.description: Set/cleared via CMD27. Same effect as PERM during the lock period; clearable.

security_features.name: Write Protect per group (CMD28/CMD29/CMD30)
security_features.description: Set, clear, or read the WP bit for an address group.

security_features.name: CPRM (Content Protection for Recordable Media)
security_features.description: Cryptographic content protection for AV content; layered above the Physical Layer; uses C2 cipher and key-management between host and card.

security_features.name: Extended Security (SCR.EX_SECURITY)
security_features.description: Extended Security version indicator; allows multi-version security stacks.

fields.no_base_layer_confidentiality: The base Physical Layer does NOT encrypt user data on the bus. An attacker with bus access can sniff plaintext blocks. Application-layer encryption (filesystem-level, or BitLocker / dm-crypt-style block encryption above the SD driver) is the recommended path for sensitive data.
fields.comparison_to_sibling_emmc: eMMC adds RPMB (Replay-Protected Memory Block) with HMAC-SHA256 authentication and a write counter, plus Secure Erase and Secure Trim. SD has no direct RPMB equivalent at the simplified spec level.
fields.notes: Security requirements at the simplified spec level are limited to data-integrity (CRC) and access control (Lock/Unlock, WP). All cryptographic content protection (CPRM, Extended Security) is in Part 3 SD Security Specification, which is out of scope of this document but referenced via SCR.SD_SECURITY and SCR.EX_SECURITY fields.
